questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has base 14 cm and height 6 cm. What is its area?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 14 × 6 = 42 cm². Skipping the ½ gives the wrong doubled answer, 84 cm².
